chain.label: Crew fatigue / operating in circadian low
chain.trigger: accident occurred about 0447, in the window of circadian low; first officer had accumulated a sleep debt from poor off-duty time management

chain.label: Variable-ceiling weather remarks not relayed to crew
chain.trigger: UPS weather system stripped METAR remarks and ATC did not append remarks to ATIS Papa, so variable ceiling info never reached the crew

chain.label: Approach encounters cloud base lower than reported
chain.trigger: estimated cloud base over the approach path was about 350 ft AFE, well below the reported 1,000-ft ceiling

chain.label: FMC flight plan not verified or sequenced
chain.trigger: the first officer did not verify that the flight plan reflected only the approach fixes; the captain did not call for verification

chain.label: Profile glidepath meaningless; autopilot fails to capture
chain.trigger: the flight plan discontinuity rendered the FMC-generated glideslope meaningless and the autopilot was unable to capture profile mode

caused_by.evidence: because the flight plan had not been properly sequenced in the FMC, the autopilot was unable to capture the profile glidepath

chain.label: Captain switches to vertical speed mode without briefing FO
chain.trigger: the captain changed the autopilot mode to vertical speed but did not brief the first officer of the change

caused_by.evidence: the captain likely perceived that the autopilot did not capture the profile glidepath and chose to change the autopilot to vertical speed mode

chain.label: Captain flies excessive-rate 'dive and drive' descent
chain.trigger: captain increased the vertical descent rate to 1,500 fpm; the approach essentially became a 'dive and drive' approach

caused_by.evidence: by selecting the vertical speed mode, the approach essentially became a 'dive and drive' approach

chain.label: Crew expects breakout at 1,000 ft, attention diverted outside
chain.trigger: first officer likely expected to see the airport soon after the 1,000-ft callout, even though the cloud base was much lower

caused_by.evidence: lack of communication about variable ceilings may have played a role in the crew's expectation that they would see the airport immediately after passing 1,000 ft
they only saw the runway about 5 seconds before impacting the trees

chain.label: First officer omits required minimums callouts
chain.trigger: the first officer did not make the required callouts regarding approaching and reaching the minimum descent altitude

caused_by.evidence: fatigue likely further negatively affected the first officer's performance
the 1,500 fpm descent rate was about twice as fast as the normal descent rate, increasing her workload
her momentary distraction from her PM duties by looking out the window when her primary responsibility was to monitor the instruments

chain.label: Unstabilized descent continues without go-around, below MDA
chain.trigger: the airplane continued to descend; neither pilot made the required callouts; the captain did not arrest the descent at the minimum descent altitude

caused_by.evidence: the captain did not arrest the descent at the minimum descent altitude
the first officer did not make the required minimums callouts
neither pilot appeared to be aware of the airplane's altitude after the first officer's 1,000-ft callout

chain.label: Airplane strikes trees and terrain short of runway
chain.trigger: the airplane struck several trees and impacted downsloping terrain in a large gulley north of the runway 18 threshold

caused_by.evidence: CVR recorded the sound of the airplane contacting trees, followed by a 'too low terrain' alert and impact noises

chain.label: Both pilots fatally injured
chain.trigger: the captain and first officer were fatally injured

caused_by.evidence: cause of death for both flight crewmembers was blunt force injuries
